value.rationale: Risk-dependent wildfire compartment design naturally optimizes expected retained area; exact 21-cell first nonrealizable canonical stage and a certified global two-unit phase jump demonstrate why extrapolating a two-segment adjacent staircase can fail. The finite sharp cutoff and explicit algebraic risk threshold give a reproducible design benchmark and a meaningful boundary without claiming field-level ecological predictions.
